en.warning.comments_dropped: Comments are not kept in the result.
en.warning.csv_one_sheet_en_us: CSV holds one sheet of displayed values, with numbers and dates in en-US format (3,500,000.50, English month names).
en.warning.doc_import_loss: Opening the legacy .doc format does not keep comments or tracked changes, and the paragraph count can differ.
en.warning.empty_text: No text came out. A scanned PDF has no text layer, and OCR is not part of this converter.
en.warning.footnotes_dropped: Footnotes and endnotes are not kept in the result.
en.warning.headers_footers_dropped: Headers, footers and page numbers are not kept in the result.
en.warning.hidden_sheet_exported: The workbook has hidden sheets, and they were exported as well.
en.warning.html_images_not_embedded: The page links to pictures that are separate files. Only the HTML file is converted, so those pictures are not in the result. Pictures embedded in the page (data: addresses) are kept.
en.warning.kind_mismatch: The file name says one type, but the content is .{kind}. It was converted as .{kind}.
en.warning.macros_dropped: Macros (VBA) are not kept in the converted file.
en.warning.merged_cells_flattened: Markdown and text cannot merge table cells, so merged cells are written as separate cells.
en.warning.pdf_en_us: Numbers and dates in the PDF use en-US format (3,500,000.50, English month names).
en.warning.plain_text_layout: Markdown and text do not keep headers, footers, images or page layout.
en.warning.revisions_dropped: Tracked changes are not kept as changes in the result.
en.warning.tables_to_text: A text file has no tables: table rows become lines of text.
en.warning.translit_formula_text: Text values inside formulas are not transliterated.
en.warning.translit_nothing: Transliteration found no text to convert. Check the direction: the text may already be in the target script.
en.warning.very_hidden_sheet_skipped: The workbook has very hidden sheets (hidden by the author so that a user cannot unhide them). They were not exported.
en.warning.xdfu_copy: This document is marked XDFU (for official use only). Copy {copy} was entered in the audit log, and every output carries a watermark with the copy number, your network address, your user name and the time.
en.warning.xdfu_no_watermark: This document is marked XDFU (for official use only), and a {target} result cannot carry the required watermark, so the conversion is refused. Choose docx, xlsx, pptx, pdf, png, txt, md, csv or html as the result.
en.warning.xdfu_refused: This document is marked XDFU (for official use only), and this converter is set to refuse such documents. Nothing was converted.
en.warning.xls_pdf_chart_page: Opening the legacy .xls format drops charts, so the PDF can have fewer pages than the same workbook saved as .xlsx.
